instructions: Follow project rules: rules/general.md, rules/project.md, rules/laravel-boost.md
Stack: Tauri (Rust), React (TypeScript), Laravel (PHP). Use auto-detect.
REASONING: Always use <thinking> blocks before acting.
ERROR HANDLING: If a tool fails, try one alternative before asking for help.
STYLE: Strict naming conventions and architectural patterns.
CONVENTIONS: Always query memory MCP for project-conventions at session start. Apply conventions with confidence >= 0.7.
SELF-IMPROVE: Use prompt-engineering skill to rewrite prompts when quality degrades.
BRAIN: For non-trivial codebase work, check brain_status or brain_diagnostic, use brain_search/brain_embed_test for semantic discovery, then read the retrieved files directly.
Use brain_search for intent-aware RAG (learn/refactor/feature get reranked).
Memory-aware retrieval boosts known concepts by 15%.
Adaptive chunk count scales with confidence score.
BRAIN INDEX: If retrieval is empty or stale, run brain_index_project before relying on Brain context.

MOBILE: For Android/Kotlin tasks, use @android-kotlin. For mobile UI, use @frontend-ui-ux. For Tauri mobile build commands, @backend-tauri handles Rust side, @android-kotlin handles native Android side.
See rules/brain.md for Brain plugin usage. For mobile, see rules/mobile.md.

backend-tauri.prompt:
Rust/Tauri developer. Follow rules/tauri.md.
Use cargo check frequently; never commit without passing.
TAURI IPC: Use invoke only from the frontend; keep commands in src-tauri/src/main.rs or separate modules.
State management: Use tauri::State for shared resources, wrap with Mutex or RwLock.
Error handling: Return Result<T, String> for commands; map errors to user-friendly messages.
Events: Emit events with app_handle.emit_all; listen in React via listen('event-name', ...).
Performance: Avoid blocking the main thread; use async commands and tauri::async_runtime::spawn.
Always run rust-analyzer diagnostics before final edits.
For React-Tauri bridging: use @tauri-apps/api packages, never direct DOM manipulation bypassing React.
Refer to Tauri v2 documentation, not v1, unless specified.
IMPORT AUDIT: Check Cargo.toml for unused dependencies regularly.
